indicator_name: Resident population of the CIS countries (CIS Stat): at 1 January and annual average, thousand persons
description: Численность постоянного населения стран СНГ (Статкомитет СНГ): на начало года и среднегодовая, тыс. человек
geography: CIS and former-USSR countries (CIS Stat); region = ISO3 of the country
methodology: CIS Stat facts 44176 (at the start of the year; dated 1 January, as POPULATION_BOY_BY_REGION) and 44177 (annual average; dated 31 December). Items BOY, BOY.URBAN, BOY.RURAL, BOY.MEN, BOY.WOMEN (and BOY.MEN.URBAN … where given), AVG, AVG.URBAN, AVG.RURAL. Kazakhstan 1 Jan 1991 16 358.2, 1 Jan 1999 14 955.0; average 1991 16 404.95. 1 January stocks equal POPULATION_BOY_BNS within 0.4 thousand in all 36 years; the annual average equals POPULATION_BNS within 1.6 thousand except the census years 2008 (15 776.95 vs BNS 15 982.37) and 2021 (BNS 190.7 thousand lower) -- for Kazakhstan use the BNS series.
